name: insurance_claim
description: Pay a motor insurance claim automatically, or hold it for an investigator
subject: policyholder
hold: Should the pending motor insurance claim be held for a claims investigator, and not paid automatically, because it shows signs of a staged accident, of an inflated claim, or of a loss that happened before the cover started?

typologies.staged_accident: Staged accident: the collision was arranged, usually by a ring that reuses the same other drivers, passengers, repair shops, clinics or lawyers across claims
typologies.inflated_claim: Inflated claim: a real loss, but the damage, the repairs or the injuries are exaggerated, or old damage is included
typologies.pre_existing_loss: Misrepresentation: the damage happened before the policy or the extra cover started, and the cover was bought to claim for it
typologies.legit: Legitimate claim for a real loss, reported honestly

reasons.new_policy: The loss happened within a few weeks of the policy start, with no continuous cover from an earlier insurer
reasons.cover_increased_before_loss: Cover was added or increased shortly before the loss
reasons.linked_to_fraud_claims: The clinic, lawyer, other driver, phone or device also appears in claims that were found to be fraud
reasons.repeat_other_party: The other driver or a passenger also appears in other recent claims
reasons.early_lawyer: A lawyer represented the claimant within days of a minor collision
reasons.injury_after_minor_impact: Injury claims followed a low-speed impact with little damage to the vehicles
reasons.estimate_above_norm: The repair estimate is far above the usual cost for this damage and this vehicle
reasons.old_damage: An inspection or a photograph shows damage that is older than the loss
reasons.evidence_predates_cover: A photograph or a document is dated before the policy or the extra cover started
reasons.inconsistent_account: The policyholder's description does not agree with the police report, the telematics or the other evidence
reasons.late_report: The loss was reported long after it happened, with no explanation
reasons.prior_claims: The policyholder made several claims in the past few years
reasons.missed_premiums: Premium payments were missed or the policy was about to lapse before the loss
reasons.filed_by_someone_else: The sign-in that reported the claim came from a device that other policyholders also sign in from, or the same visit reported claims for other policyholders. A shared clinic, lawyer or repair shop is not this
reasons.claim_planned_at_purchase: The visit that bought or upgraded the cover also looked up how to make a claim
reasons.photos_not_taken_at_report: The photos were uploaded from the phone's gallery, not taken with the app when the loss was reported
